title: Simpson's Paradox in Recommender Fairness: Reconciling differences between per-user and aggregated evaluations
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on reconciling per-user and aggregated fairness evaluations in recommender systems, a phenomenon it frames as an instance of Simpson's Paradox.
